talk.jaymoskingdoms.blood_chore.start.2: That'll stain the boards if it sits. Where's my brush?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.blood_chore.start.3: Gods, the smell will be in the walls for a week.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.blood_chore.start.4: I'm not living with that on the floor.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.blood_chore.start.5: Fetch the bucket, somebody's made a mess.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.blood_chore.start.6: Before it dries. Always before it dries.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.blood_chore.start.7: This is a home, not a butcher's yard.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.blood_chore.start.8: It'll draw flies. Out it comes.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.blood_chore.start.9: Whoever bled here can come and scrub it next time.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.blood_chore.start.10: Water and straw. That's all it takes, if you're quick.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.blood_chore.start.11: Not on the good floor. Not on the good floor!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.blood_chore.done.3: My arms ache. Still, it's gone.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.blood_chore.done.5: Now nobody track it about again.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.blood_chore.done.7: Gone. The smell can follow it out.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.blood_chore.done.10: If it had dried I'd still be at it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.blood_chore.done.11: There. Let's not do that again.
